ROW.COLUMN: (IML/CU) CIB: Significant Change in Trade/Transaction Activity

This scenario focuses on customers for which the aggregated number and amount of current month trades or transactions changed by a defined percentage of all the associated accounts versus the average number and average amount of the historical trades or transactions for all associated accounts with the same customer. In addition to the changes in the number and amount of current month trades or transactions, the scenario checks the activity including wire transactions to high-risk geography, wire transactions and changes in standing instructions, wire transactions to third parties, journals between unrelated accounts, or the focal customer is a high-risk entity to generate alerts.

The main objective of this pattern is to find focal entity (CUSTOMER) with trade/trans activity on his accounts standing out of average historical trade/trans activity. This pattern consists of Primary Rule, Sub-Rule, Check-point and one more Sub Rule. Primary Rule creates set of Customers with its current month activity checked with TSD scenario restrictive parameters and Orion scenario library parameters. Sub-Rule calculates average historical activity level of all focal entities and stores it to bind variables. Check-Point does alert generation comparing month and historical activity level of each focal entity. And final Sub Rule stores account information for account supporting data matches.

WHERE asm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT <= (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL b where b.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' and b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and asm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT > (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL b where b.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED2' and b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and (select min(ac.ACCT_OPEN_DT) from @MINER@.ACCT ac where cu.CUST_INTRL_ID = ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID group by ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID) <= (select add_days(kc.CLNDR_DT, -@Opn_Days_No) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and cu.CUST_TYPE_CD in ('FIN','ORG') and cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR cu.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) --28464311 and a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in ('CI') and (@All_Acct_Type_Fl = 'Y' OR a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD IN (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst)) --
GROUP BY cu.CUST_INTRL_ID , cu.CUST_SEQ_ID , cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB

( sum(asm.THRD_PARTY_WIRE_IN_CT) > 0 or sum(asm.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT) > 0 or sum(asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_CT) > 0 -- Incoming_Jrnl_Ct > 0 or cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl or sum(asm.THRD_PARTY_WIRES_OUT_CT) > 0 or sum(asm.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT) > 0 or sum(asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_CT) > 0 -- Outgoing_Jrnl_Ct > 0 or (sum(iasm.STNDG_INSTN_CHG_CT) > 0 and (sum(asm.WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT + asm.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT) >0) ) -- (Incoming_Wire_Ct + Outgoing_Wire_Ct ) > 0 ) and ( (sum(asm.TOT_BUY_CT) >= @Min_Trade_Ct and sum(asm.TOT_BUY_AM) >= @Min_Trade_Am) or (sum(asm.WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT) >= @Min_Wire_Ct and sum(asm.WIRE_TRXN_IN_AM) >= @Min_Wire_Am) or (sum(asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_CT) >= @Min_Jrnl_Ct and sum(asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_AM) >= @Min_Jrnl_Am) or (sum(asm.TOT_SELL_CT) >= @Min_Trade_Ct and sum(asm.TOT_SELL_AM) >= @Min_Trade_Am) or (sum(asm.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT) >= @Min_Wire_Ct and sum(asm.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_AM) >= @Min_Wire_Am) or (sum(asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_CT) >= @Min_Jrnl_Ct and sum(asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_AM) >= @Min_Jrnl_Am) )
